settings.textSize.title: Text size
settings.textSize.body: Makes menu text bigger or smaller. Helpful on a phone, a TV or an arcade screen across the room.
settings.arrivalDiscs.title: Floating discs outside the hideout
settings.arrivalDiscs.body: Show the soundtrack as slow-turning discs above the rain on the arrival screen. Tap the middle disc to play it. Turn this off for the plain rain scene.
hub.room.jukebox.label: Jukebox Room
crash.recovered.title: Lok caught a crash
crash.recovered.body: The game closed unexpectedly last time. A report was saved on this device and sent to Lok if reports are on. Copy it if you can share it.
settings.jukebox.title: Jukebox & soundtracks
settings.jukebox.intro: Everything about the music in one place: the floating discs, their pulse, the Jukebox Room and the soundtrack itself.
settings.jukebox.volumeBody: The soundtrack level, {{percent}}%. The same slider as in the Audio section.
settings.jukebox.reactBody: The game listens to the playing track and moves with its tempo. Off plays the game exactly as in silence.
settings.jukebox.pulseBody: A neon pulse around the playing disc that moves with the beat. Soft is gentler and lighter on phones.
settings.jukebox.fxBody: Switch each pulse effect on or off. Beat pulse is locked to the song's own beat, treble shimmer sparkles with the highs, change burst flashes when you move between discs, tempo spin turns the arcs at the song's BPM, and disc size makes the disc itself breathe with the music (off by default). Changes apply next time the discs open.
settings.jukebox.bgBody: The Jukebox Room and the arrival screen glow and breathe with the music. Soft is gentler and lighter on phones.
settings.jukebox.autoplayBody: Start the soundtrack on your first tap, so there is music without opening the player.
settings.jukebox.shuffleBody: Pick the next song at random instead of in album order. Remembered between visits.
settings.jukebox.repeatBody: Tap to cycle: off, all songs, or the same song.
settings.jukebox.theaterBody: In the Jukebox Room the menus fade away and the mix opens up as you leave it alone.
music.newFits.body: New Fits is an expansion playlist from guest artists, open from the start. DJ Misfit is the first featured artist, and more songs will be added over time.
lokChat.mailBlurb: Training notes, finds and anything the toasts caught.
lokChat.cmd.pickSomeone: Pick someone from the list to talk to, or try /help for tricks.
lokChat.cmd.help: Tricks: /roll 2d6 · /flip · /8ball question · /pick a, b or c · /rps rock · /rate anything · /fortune · /vibe · /616 · /me waves · /shrug · /time · /confetti · /disco · /mail · /clear
lokChat.cmd.unknown: No trick called {{cmd}}. Type /help to see them all.
lokChat.cmd.roll.usage: Try /roll, /roll d6 or /roll 3d8 (up to 10 dice, up to 100 sides).
lokChat.cmd.ball.usage: Ask a question first, like /8ball will it rain on the strip tonight
lokChat.cmd.pick.usage: Give me two or more options, like /pick tacos, pizza or soup
lokChat.cmd.rate.usage: Tell me what to rate, like /rate the rain
lokChat.cmd.rps.win: You threw {{you}}, I threw {{bot}}. You win.
lokChat.cmd.rps.lose: You threw {{you}}, I threw {{bot}}. I win.
lokChat.cmd.time.late: It is {{time}}. Even the streetlights are yawning.
lokChat.cmd.time.morning: It is {{time}}. Morning light on the Grand River.
lokChat.cmd.time.day: It is {{time}}. Plenty of daylight left for a run.
lokChat.cmd.time.night: It is {{time}}. The strip is waking up.
lokChat.cmd.ball.0: Signs point to yes. Probably the neon ones.
lokChat.cmd.ball.2: Ask again after a Block cleared.
lokChat.cmd.ball.5: Better not to tell you now.
lokChat.cmd.fortune.0: A locked door is only a door you have not met the key for.
lokChat.cmd.fortune.1: Someone near you is about to say something kind.
lokChat.cmd.fortune.2: The next corner has a better angle.
lokChat.cmd.fortune.3: Your next find is hiding behind the thing you almost skipped.
lokChat.cmd.fortune.4: Slow is smooth. Smooth is how you stay alive.
lokChat.cmd.fortune.5: A small win tonight, a bigger one tomorrow.
lokChat.cmd.fortune.6: The crew is rooting for you more than they let on.
lokChat.cmd.fortune.7: Something that looks like trouble is a gift in a hoodie.
lokChat.cmd.vibe.0: Vibe check: calm, slightly caffeinated, ready.
lokChat.cmd.vibe.1: Vibe check: main character, rain on the window.
lokChat.cmd.vibe.4: Vibe check: soft launch of a very good idea.
lokChat.cmd.vibe.5: Vibe check: neon, a little rainy, all heart.
lokChat.cmd.fact.0: 616 is the area code for Grand Rapids, and the game wears it like a jersey.
lokChat.cmd.fact.1: The Hideout is warmest when everyone you rescued is home.
lokChat.cmd.fact.2: Ice blocks slide, glass blocks shatter, and both remember every hit.
lokChat.cmd.fact.3: The rain on the arrival screen is the loudest it will ever be. Step inside and it softens.
lokChat.cmd.fact.4: Every disc on the shelf is drawn in code. No pictures, no network.
lokChat.cmd.fact.5: The crew's chatter around the hideout is saved in #hideout, so you can catch up later.
lokChat.cmd.fact.6: Swipe left or right on a menu page and the bottom bar follows your finger.
lokChat.cmd.fact.7: New Fits is the playlist where guest artists play on your soundtrack.
arrival.discsFailed.title: Discs didn't load
arrival.discsFailed.body: The disc shelf couldn't start. Tap to refresh and try again.
arrival.discsOff.body: Floating discs are off. Tap to turn them back on.
arrival.discsEmpty.body: No discs on the shelf yet. Add tracks in the Soundtrack panel.
arrival.discsPaused.title: Discs paused
arrival.discsPaused.body: The game closed while the discs were showing, so they took a break. Tap to bring them back in the lightest mode.
jukebox.sealed.title: Sealed disc · Track {{n}}
jukebox.sealed.hint: Lok: finish {{need}} run objectives in total to open this one. You have done {{have}}, so {{left}} to go.
jukebox.title: Jukebox Room
jukebox.theaterMix: Theater mix (clearer sound when the screen goes dark)
settings.crashReports.title: Send crash reports
settings.crashReports.body: If the game crashes, send the error text, game version, screen name and browser type so it can be fixed. No account, no device id, nothing about you. Browsers set to Do Not Track never send.

settings.audioLevel.turnedOff: Turn this layer on above to hear it.

settings.damageNumbers.title: Damage numbers
settings.damageNumbers.description: Classic is the original short yellow number. Cascade keeps numbers up longer, stacks them above each enemy, and shifts color and size as hits get bigger. Display only; never changes damage.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Controls & accessibility
controls.keyboard.title: Keyboard
controls.keyboard.intro: Click a button, then press the key you want. If another action already uses that key, the two swap.
controls.keyboard.fixed: Move with W A S D or the arrow keys. Those stay fixed so you can never lock yourself out of walking. P also pauses.
controls.mouse.title: Mouse
controls.mouse.intro: The mouse steers by dragging, same as a finger.
controls.mouse.doubleClickHint: Double-click the playfield to dash toward the pointer.
controls.pad.title: Controller
controls.pad.intro: Plug in or wake a controller and press any button. The left stick and d-pad move you.
controls.pad.deadzoneHint: Raise it if your character drifts when you are not touching the stick.
controls.pad.fixed: Click a button, then press the controller button you want. Swaps with whatever had it.
controls.touch.title: Touch
controls.touch.intro: Drag anywhere to steer. These add the dash.
controls.touch.dashButtonHint: Shows a Dash button above the Ultimate button. It also appears on desktop.
controls.touch.doubleTapHint: Double-tap the playfield to dash toward the tap.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.description: Pick a language, or leave this on Match my device to follow your browser or phone language, including when you change it. Translations are made automatically, so some wording may be off, and anything not translated yet stays in English. This device only.
settings.fightStyle.title: Travel fight style
settings.fightStyle.description: How a travel encounter plays out. Classic is the original card-throw popup. The other three use your lead LokPet on the arena engine, and their layout adapts to your screen. This device only.
settings.fightStyle.classic.label: Classic
settings.fightStyle.classic.blurb: The original card-throw popup. Throw a Battle Deck card or a punch.
settings.fightStyle.quick.label: Quick
settings.fightStyle.quick.blurb: Your lead LokPet, three moves, at most eight rounds, next enemy move shown.
settings.fightStyle.duo.label: Duo
settings.fightStyle.duo.blurb: Operator and LokPet fight together: pick a LokPet move and an operator assist every round. Bring your selected team and swap LokPets mid-fight.
settings.fightStyle.arena.label: Arena
settings.fightStyle.arena.blurb: The full battle: every move including finishers, Cheer, up to twenty rounds. Bring your selected team and swap LokPets mid-fight.

overlay.ability.freeze: F: freeze cone, then press F again to throw
overlay.ability.draw: F: draw a line ahead and dash through it
hub.nav.hideout.title: Hideout
hub.nav.hideout.note: Safe rooms. Nothing in here will jump you.
hub.nav.travel.title: Travel
hub.nav.travel.note: Out in the city. You can be ambushed on the way there.
hub.nav.travel.noteOff: Out in the city. Ambushes are switched off in Settings.
hub.directionPanel.title: Directions
hub.armory.hideoutEntranceBlurb: The Luvitnot keeper holds a safe entrance here
hub.armory.stationUnfound: The GRPD Station is still unfound, so the keeper holds the Armory in the hideout for now.
fight.switch.title: Switch LokPet
fight.switch.hint: Costs your turn. The opponent still strikes.
hideout.prop.bell-cord.label: Bell cord
hideout.scene.title: Hideout scene
hideout.scene.description: Your operator, selected LokPets, and rescued crew are animated together in the cage. Switch to the old block scene any time.
hideout.scene.chatDescription: Hide or show character chat bubbles in the hideout.
hideout.scene.encourageReply: You've got this. We're right here!
hideout.prop.bell-cord.line.1: You give the cord a tug. Somewhere, a tip jar jingles.
hideout.prop.relay-crate.label: Relay Crate
hideout.prop.relay-crate.line.1: The crate hums as it passes along whatever was left for you.
hideout.prop.relay-crate.line.2: Someone keeps restocking it. You decide not to ask who.
hideout.prop.relay-crate.rare: A false bottom! A LokPet treat is wedged under the packing.
hideout.prop.window-seat.label: Window seat
hideout.prop.window-seat.line.1: You sit a while. The block looks smaller from up here.
hideout.prop.window-seat.line.2: A bus goes by, every window lit and empty.
hideout.prop.window-seat.line.3: For a minute, nothing needs you. It helps.
hideout.prop.fire-escape-stash.label: Fire-escape stash
hideout.prop.fire-escape-stash.line.1: A loose grate, a taped-up bag. Someone trusts you with this.
hideout.prop.fire-escape-stash.line.2: You check the street, then the stash. Quick and quiet.
hideout.prop.fire-escape-stash.rare: Taped under the grate: a sealed elixir vial.
hideout.prop.stoop-cat.label: Stoop cat
hideout.prop.stoop-cat.line.1: The cat watches you with total, bored authority.
hideout.prop.stoop-cat.line.2: It slow-blinks. That is as close to a greeting as you get.
hideout.prop.beacon-lamp.label: Beacon Lamp
hideout.prop.beacon-lamp.line.1: You trim the wick. The Beacon Lamp throws a warm circle over the roof.
hideout.prop.beacon-lamp.line.2: Lit for whoever is still out there. Someone left a tip in the dish.
hideout.prop.old-telescope.label: Old telescope
hideout.prop.old-telescope.line.1: The brass is cold. The lens is clear. The sky is up to something.
hideout.prop.old-telescope.line.2: You squint through it. Rooftops, water towers, one very still pigeon.
hideout.prop.static-jar.label: Static Jar
hideout.prop.static-jar.line.1: The Static Jar fizzes. A few coins' worth of sparks drift to the bottom.
hideout.prop.static-jar.line.2: You tap the glass. It tingles. Good luck, probably.
hideout.prop.static-jar.rare: The jar crackles and coughs up a card credit chip.
hideout.prop.luvitnot-keeper.label: Armory keeper
hideout.prop.luvitnot-keeper.line.1: The keeper tilts their glass helmet. "The Armory is open to you."
hideout.prop.luvitnot-keeper.line.2: "Take what you need. Return what you borrow."
hideout.prop.pulse-jukebox.label: Pulse Jukebox
hideout.prop.pulse-jukebox.line.1: The Pulse Jukebox warms up with a low, patient hum.
hideout.prop.pulse-jukebox.line.2: It flickers through your tracks, hunting for one that fits the room.
egg.perfect-legend.title: Perfect L13gend
egg.perfect-legend.line: A tip of the cap to one of the greatest fighting game players ever, a champion who picked up a controller at age three and never stopped winning.
egg.bridge-616.title: 616 Stays Winning
egg.bridge-616.line: Somewhere over the Grand River, a bridge light blinks twice. It knows your name.
egg.owl-wink.title: Hoot
egg.owl-wink.line: A pair of owl eyes blinks from the dark of the menu. Friendly. Probably selling something.
egg.static-mite.title: Static Mite
egg.static-mite.line: A tiny Digi mite scurries across the title. Nobody has caught it yet.
egg.ten-hit-combo.title: Ten-Hit Combo
egg.ten-hit-combo.line: You typed it like you meant it. Respect.
hideout.prop.sky-spyglass.label: Sky Spyglass
hideout.prop.sky-spyglass.line.1: You lean on the brass rail and tilt the spyglass toward the sky.
hideout.prop.sky-spyglass.line.2: The lens is cold. Somewhere up there, something is always happening.
sky.clear.title: Clear Sky
sky.clear.line: Nothing but stars and the hum of the city. Check again in a couple of hours.
sky.glyphs.title: Glyphs in the Sky
sky.glyphs.line: Glowing glyphs drift overhead and your whole crew feels charged. +10% to every stat for an hour.
sky.eclipse.title: Eclipse
sky.eclipse.line: The sun is swallowed whole and every fighter feels sharper. +5% experience for an hour.
sky.eclipse-glyphs.title: Glyph Eclipse
sky.eclipse-glyphs.line: An eclipse with glyphs burning across it. +15% to every stat and +5% experience for an hour.
sky.running: Already boosted by {{title}}. Come back after the next change in the sky.
hideout.prop.lucky-chest.label: Lucky Chest
hideout.prop.lucky-chest.line.1: A brass-cornered chest that nobody remembers carrying in.
hideout.prop.lucky-chest.line.2: It rattles when you walk past. It knows.
chest.away: The chest is not here right now. It turns up every so often, so check back later.
chest.opened: You already opened this one. Wait for the next time it turns up.
photosensitivity.short.title: Photosensitivity warning
photosensitivity.short.line: Flashing lights and effects in this game may trigger seizures in some people.
photosensitivity.title: Seizure and photosensitivity warning
photosensitivity.body: A small number of people can have seizures or blackouts when they see flashing lights or certain patterns, even if they have never had a seizure or been diagnosed with epilepsy. 616 Survivor contains effects that can trigger this.
photosensitivity.trigger1: Rapid flashes and strobing from hits, explosions and ultimates
photosensitivity.trigger2: Bright bursts of light and glow against dark scenes
photosensitivity.trigger3: Screen shake and fast, busy motion with many effects at once
photosensitivity.stopTitle: Stop playing right away if you feel
photosensitivity.stop: dizziness, blurred vision, eye or face twitching, jerking or shaking, confusion, or nausea. Rest in a well-lit room and talk to a doctor before playing again.
photosensitivity.safer: Play safer: sit back from the screen, keep the room lit, take regular breaks, and don't play when tired. If you or a family member has a history of seizures, check with a doctor first.
photosensitivity.tip: Tip: turn on Reduce flashes and turn off Screen shake in Settings at any time.
hideout.prop.lok-shop-counter.label: LokShop Counter
hideout.prop.lok-shop-counter.line.1: A glowing counter hums. Two round eyes blink back at you from the screen.
hideout.prop.lok-shop-counter.line.2: Someone is always behind the counter, even when nobody is.
wallet.signedOut: Sign in to see and spend your LokTokens.
lokshop.title: LokShop
lokshop.subtitle: Run by LokServer. Everything is paid in LokTokens.
lokshop.signInNotice: Sign in from the Account room to earn and spend LokTokens.
lokshop.failed: Couldn't complete the purchase. You were not charged.
lokshop.support.title: Lok Supporters
lokshop.support.blurb: Lok Pass and Lok Passport are subscriptions that keep the Lok games going. Supporters stream across the bottom of the game and on gsix.online, and stay there for good, even if a subscription ends. Lifetime is one payment: a gold founder mark and every premium feature in every Lok app, permanently.
lokshop.support.showMe: Show my name on the supporter bar
lokshop.charms.title: Feather Charms
lokshop.game.title: Pick a feather
lokshop.game.blurb: One of three feathers is golden. Win rapport, and sometimes a charm.
lokshop.back.locked: The back room opens at Favorite rapport, or with a Lok Pass or Passport.
lokshop.back.body: Shelf notes, kept for friends only. These are the things LokServer is planning to stock.
lokshop.item.ball.name: Ball
lokshop.item.ball.blurb: Drops on the ground. Click it, your character grabs it and throws it, and your LokPets race for it.
lokshop.item.chest-pass.name: Chest Pass
lokshop.item.chest-pass.blurb: Lasts 3 rounds and lets the Lucky Chest hold the extra loot from your runs.
lokshop.item.pet-rider-saddle.name: Rider Saddle
lokshop.item.pet-rider-saddle.blurb: A planned way for a LokPet to ride along on your back through a run.
hub.room.lok-shop.label: LokShop
hub.room.lok-shop.description: Chat with LokServer and see what is on the shelf.
hideout.ball.hint: Tap the ball to fetch it, then tap to throw. Your LokPets race for it.
sky.spur: A Light Spur streaks over {{name}}, where the Digi are moving all wrong. The place is now open to you.
hideout.ambient.llama: A llama trots right across the street like it owns the place.
hideout.ambient.running-man: Someone sprints past, late for something they will not explain.
hideout.ambient.courier: A courier jogs by with a parcel, checking a very long list.
hideout.ambient.digi-mite: A tiny Digi mite skitters in. Tap it before it chews the wiring.
hideout.ambient.title: Street life
eventbuff.warm-heart.name: Warm Heart
eventbuff.borrowed-luck.name: Borrowed Luck
eventbuff.steady-breath.name: Steady Breath
eventbuff.sharp-eyes.name: Sharp Eyes
eventbuff.quick-hands.name: Quick Hands

hideout.life.capped: Your pockets are full for today. Try again tomorrow.
hideout.life.eventChipAria: Something is happening nearby. Tap to see.
hideout.life.stripAria: Your operator and LokPets in the hideout. Tap the ground or press the left and right arrow keys to walk. Tap a prop to use it.
hideout.life.stripAriaPlain: Your operator and LokPets in the hideout.
settings.hideout.walk.title: Walk and props
settings.hideout.walk.description: Walk your operator with taps or the arrow keys, and use the props around each room.
settings.hideout.play.title: Pet play
settings.hideout.play.description: A row of things to do with your LokPet under the strip: scratch, fetch, nap together and more.
settings.hideout.choice.title: Choice events
settings.hideout.choice.description: Now and then something comes up while you move around, and you decide what to do. Never forced on you.
settings.runEvents.title: Run events
settings.runEvents.description: Moments that can happen mid-run once you have cleared a few maps. Switch off any you would rather not see.
settings.crewTalk.title: Crew chatter
settings.crewTalk.description: What your rescued crew say when you walk up to them in a room.
settings.crewTalk.toneDescription: Family keeps it warm and gentle. Wry adds drier, more grown-up humor. Both stay fine for a child to read.
settings.hideout.notice.title: Note duration
settings.hideout.notice.description: How long the notes in the hideout corner stay up before fading.
hideout.care.scratch.label: Scratch
hideout.care.scratch.hint: Behind the ears. Shy and sleepy pets love it.
hideout.care.scratch.loved: {{pet}} melts into your hand and will not let you stop.
hideout.care.scratch.liked: {{pet}} leans in and holds still for it.
hideout.care.scratch.meh: {{pet}} puts up with it, then wanders off.
hideout.care.fetch.label: Fetch
hideout.care.fetch.hint: A quick dash. Bouncy and bold pets live for it.
hideout.care.fetch.loved: {{pet}} streaks off and is back before you finish throwing.
hideout.care.fetch.liked: {{pet}} fetches it, then looks at you for another.
hideout.care.fetch.meh: {{pet}} watches the toy land, then looks at you like you did that.
hideout.care.boogie.label: Boogie
hideout.care.boogie.hint: Needs music playing. Bouncy pets cannot help themselves.
hideout.care.boogie.loved: {{pet}} loses it completely. Four spins and a hop, all on the beat.
hideout.care.boogie.meh: {{pet}} sways a little. That is a lot, for them.
hideout.care.snack-break.label: Snack break
hideout.care.snack-break.hint: Share a bite on the stoop. Chill pets savor it.
hideout.care.snack-break.loved: {{pet}} makes it last, one slow bite at a time.
hideout.care.snack-break.liked: {{pet}} polishes off its share and checks yours.
hideout.care.snack-break.meh: {{pet}} eats fast and looks around for more.
hideout.care.nap-together.label: Nap together
hideout.care.nap-together.hint: Evenings and nights. Sleepy pets take it very seriously.
hideout.care.nap-together.loved: {{pet}} curls up against you and is asleep in seconds.
hideout.care.nap-together.liked: {{pet}} settles in beside you for a while.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.label: Sniff hunt
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.hint: Needs a Familiar bond. Your pet sniffs out whatever the block lost.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.loved: {{pet}} follows a scent straight to something worth finding.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.liked: {{pet}} sniffs around and turns something up.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.meh: {{pet}} sniffs, sneezes, and finds a little something anyway.
hideout.care.sniff-hunt.rare: {{pet}} digs a sealed elixir vial out from behind a pipe!
hideout.play.title: Play with {{pet}}
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.title: Stray at the door
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.body: A thin stray is sitting by the door, watching you with one ear up.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.feed.1: It eats, then leaves something shiny on the step.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.feed.2: It eats, leans against your leg, and trots off. You feel warm and quick, though it took your attention.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.feed.3: It drops a LokPet treat at your feet, like a thank-you.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.shoo.1: It slinks off. The doorway feels a little colder.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.pet.1: {{pet}} sniffs once, then lets the stray stay close. You both feel better for it.
hideout.event.stray-at-the-door.o.pet.2: {{pet}} trades a long look with the stray and comes back looking proud.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.title: Dropped satchel
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.body: Someone's satchel is sitting on a step, zipped shut. Nobody is around.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.open.1: A few crumpled bills and a gum wrapper. Better than nothing.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.open.2: Mostly receipts, but one is a lucky lottery stub. Things drift toward you now, though you feel a little exposed.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.open.3: Tucked in the lining: a card credit chip.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.c.hand-in: Hand it in at the GRPD desk
The desk sergeant nods. A day later, a thank-you note and a few cred turn up.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.sniff.1: {{pet}} nudges the zip open with a paw. Nothing dangerous, just spare cred.
hideout.event.dropped-satchel.o.sniff.2: {{pet}} sneezes and loses interest. You open it yourself: nothing.
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.title: Busker on the corner
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.body: Someone is playing a battered keyboard on the corner, with a hat out and no one stopping.
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.o.lis: You stay for the whole song. Walking on, you feel lighter.
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.o.req: They play it. The whole block hums along.
They do not know it, but what they play sets your hands moving faster. Your reach feels a bit short after.
hideout.event.busker-on-the-corner.o.joi: You keep time on an upturned bucket. Strangers clap.
You miss every beat and strangers clap anyway. The cheer lifts your step, but your punches go soft.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.title: A light past the water towers
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.body: Past the water towers, a thin light rises and winks out.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.follow.1: You track it to a rooftop garden. Someone waves.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.follow.2: Just a drone doing laps, but you spot its pattern and your eyes sharpen. You are a little jumpy for it.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.follow.3: A tiny canister drifts down on a scrap of parachute. Inside: a sealed elixir vial.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.log.1: The notebook fills up. You feel like you know the sky a little better.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.wave.1: The light blinks twice. Somebody was waiting for that.
hideout.event.rooftop-flare.o.wave.2: Nothing answers, but for a second you felt seen and steady. Your legs are heavier for it.
hideout.event.pigeon-census.title: Pigeon census
hideout.event.pigeon-census.body: Through the telescope, one very still pigeon is staring straight back at you.
hideout.event.pigeon-census.o.count.1: Forty-one pigeons, give or take. You write it down like it matters.
hideout.event.pigeon-census.o.salute.1: It bobs once. You are almost sure that was respect.
hideout.event.pigeon-census.o.salute.2: It leaves, rude and a little impressive. You stand taller and tougher, and a bit slower.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.title: Leaking pipe
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.body: A pipe on the cellar ceiling is dripping something faintly bright into a puddle.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.patch.1: A strip of tape and a lot of grumbling. The drip stops, and someone leaves a few cred in thanks.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.patch.2: The tape will not hold, so you swing the wrench wide and it somehow works. Everything takes a beat longer now.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.collect.1: A jar's worth of something that fizzes. The jars seem to like it.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.collect.2: The jar fills with static, and a card credit pings into it.
hideout.event.leaking-pipe.o.leave.1: Drip. Drip. Drip. You will hear it in your sleep.
hideout.event.lost-leash.title: A lost leash
hideout.event.lost-leash.body: A bright red leash is lying across the sidewalk, one end still clipped to a lamppost.
hideout.event.lost-leash.o.return.1: You find them two blocks over, frantic. They press a few cred on you.
hideout.event.lost-leash.o.return.2: Nobody is looking for it. You leave it hooked on the lamppost, where it can be found.
hideout.event.lost-leash.o.keep.1: It is a good leash. Nobody comes asking. You feel slightly strange about it.
hideout.event.lost-leash.o.ask.1: {{pet}} sniffs the leash, then the air, then points you the right way. Everyone ends up happy.
hideout.event.pet-dream.title: A restless sleeper
hideout.event.pet-dream.body: {{pet}} twitches in its sleep, paws moving like it is running somewhere far away.
hideout.event.pet-dream.o.wake.1: {{pet}} blinks up at you, a little confused, and leans in.
hideout.event.pet-dream.o.dream.1: Whatever it saw, {{pet}} wakes up lighter.
hideout.event.pet-dream.o.sit.1: {{pet}} wakes, finds you right there, and does not move for a long time.
hideout.event.pet-dream.o.sit.2: {{pet}} presses something into your hand when it wakes: a sealed elixir vial.
hideout.event.long-way-round.title: The long way round
hideout.event.long-way-round.body: You have wandered a while. The block looks different from here.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.long.1: You find a coin wedged in a drain. Good luck, probably.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.long.2: Nothing happens, and it was still a good walk. You breathe easy and stand sturdier, though your pace slows.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.short.1: Quick and quiet. You are home before the kettle clicks off.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.short.2: A cat glares at you from a bin. You back out slowly.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.follow.1: {{pet}} leads you to a spot with a view. You both sit and watch the street.
hideout.event.long-way-round.o.follow.2: {{pet}} leads you in a circle and looks extremely pleased with itself.
hideout.event.ui.fizzle: You almost found something special, but the moment slips away. You still come away with a little.
sleeve.title: Sleeve Counter
sleeve.intro: Dress up your LokPacks. Wrappers, card backs and card frames are cosmetic only: they never change pack odds, prices or card stats.
sleeve.motion.label: Card motion
sleeve.kind.packSkin.hint: How the packs on the counter look.
sleeve.kind.cardBack.hint: Shown face-down while you open a pack.
sleeve.kind.cardFrame.hint: How your collected cards are laid out and bordered.
settings.cardMotion.title: Card motion
settings.cardMotion.body: Pack wrappers, card backs and card frames can tilt toward your cursor and shimmer. Full does both, Subtle only reacts when you hover, Off keeps everything still. Devices set to reduce motion stay still automatically.
forge.style.label: Look
forge.style.classicHint: Classic v1 uses the original plain operator build. Your detailed v2 features are kept and come back when you switch.
forge.variants.enemiesIntro: Classic enemies as they appear in a run. Recolor one and save it as a custom look. Stats and behavior never change.
forge.variants.petsIntro: Classic LokPets with their original silhouettes. Recolor one and save it as a custom look. Abilities and stats never change.
forge.variants.full: Saved list is full. Delete one to make room.
endgame.runs.masterBody: Master switch. Off keeps every custom operator, enemy look and LokPet look out of your runs. They stay saved.
endgame.runs.reload: Operator changes need a reload to reach the roster. Looks apply to your next run.
endgame.dock.setting: Show Endgame dock in the hideout
endgame.dock.settingBody: A small panel in the hideout with your endgame switches and shortcuts.
endgame.dock.title: Endgame
endgame.table.title: Everything the end game unlocks
bestiary.custom.empty: Nothing here yet. Recolor an enemy or LokPet in the Forge and save it.
hideout.event.roof-leak.title: Drip, drip, drip
hideout.event.roof-leak.body: Rain has found a gap in the awning and is dripping right onto the good rug.
hideout.event.roof-leak.o.bucket.1: The bucket fills fast. Someone slides you a few coins for saving the rug.
hideout.event.roof-leak.o.bucket.2: Plink, plink. The rug stays dry and the room smells like rain.
hideout.event.roof-leak.o.patch.1: A tarp and some tape later, the drip stops. The crew cheers from below.
hideout.event.roof-leak.o.patch.2: You get soaked, but the gap is sealed.
hideout.event.roof-leak.o.drip.1: The rug has seen worse. Probably.
hideout.event.fog-horn.title: A horn in the fog
hideout.event.fog-horn.body: Somewhere out in the fog a horn sounds twice, slow, like it is asking something.
hideout.event.fog-horn.o.answer.1: The horn sounds again, closer, and someone leaves a few coins at the door.
hideout.event.fog-horn.o.answer.2: Two blinks back. The fog swallows the reply, but it felt right.
hideout.event.fog-horn.o.answer.3: A courier leaves a card pack stub on the step with a nod.
hideout.event.fog-horn.o.quiet.1: The horn fades. The fog keeps its secret.
hideout.event.fog-wander.title: Gone in the fog
hideout.event.fog-wander.body: {{pet}} trotted three steps into the fog and is now nowhere to be seen.
hideout.event.fog-wander.o.call.1: {{pet}} bounds out of the white with something in its mouth, very pleased with itself.
hideout.event.fog-wander.o.call.2: {{pet}} appears right behind you. It was there the whole time.
hideout.event.fog-wander.o.wait.1: After a while {{pet}} wanders back, damp and calm.
hideout.event.fog-wander.o.wait.2: The fog lifts. {{pet}} is sitting on the step like nothing happened.
hideout.event.crew-card-night.title: Card night
hideout.event.crew-card-night.body: Late at night the crew sets up a game on an upturned crate and one chair is empty.
hideout.event.crew-card-night.o.deal.1: You win a small pot and lose it again on the next hand. Net: a good time.
hideout.event.crew-card-night.o.deal.2: A lucky run. The crew insists you take a little for the night.
hideout.event.crew-card-night.o.watch.1: You pick up a few tells and a lot of gossip.
hideout.event.crew-card-night.o.tidy.1: A thank-you tip appears under your mug.
hideout.event.crew-card-night.o.tidy.2: Nobody notices. You notice, and that is enough.
hideout.event.warm-glass.title: The glass is warm
hideout.event.warm-glass.body: The glass growths are putting out a gentle heat and every pane hums.
hideout.event.warm-glass.o.polish.1: The glow brightens and someone drops a few coins in the jar.
hideout.event.warm-glass.o.polish.2: A few panes come up clean and bright.
hideout.event.warm-glass.o.listen.1: You hear a note nobody taught the pipes. It stays with you.
hideout.event.warm-glass.o.listen.2: A slow rhythm in the glass. You tap along.
booster.eyebrow: Bootleg stock · Not affiliated with anyone
booster.title: Bootleg Booster Bin
booster.intro: Ghosted copies of familiar faces. Every booster adds a random stat for every run. Results may vary, and so may the character on the card.
booster.empty: No boosters yet. The bin is well stocked. Honest.
training.hub.title: Training Arena
training.hub.open: Test the unlocked weapon rack against a Dust Mite.
training.hub.shopHint: Buy Weapon Rack access in the LokShop.
training.header.title: Training Arena
training.layout.label: Training arena layout
training.rack.title: Weapon rack
training.rack.help: Click a weapon to fire. Use the arrow for details.
training.rack.detailsLocked: Details locked; this control activates the weapon
training.rack.allLevelsHelp: Raise or lower every weapon to the same level
training.rack.multiLocked: Multi-Weapon Testing unlocks at 1,000,000 dummy damage.
training.loadouts.name: Loadout name
training.loadouts.empty: No saved loadouts in this group yet.
training.stats.title: Attack readout
training.effects.title: Effects observed
training.status.reset: Dust Mite reset. Ready for another test.
training.status.durability: Dust Mite durability set to {{hp}} HP.
training.status.locked: Buy Weapon Rack access in the LokShop to enter the Training Arena.
training.mailbox.label: Notifications
training.mailbox.title: Notification mailbox
training.mailbox.subtitle: Unlock notices stay here after their toast closes.
training.shop.name: Training Arena Weapon Rack
training.shop.description: Opens the Training Arena. Earn 616 defeats with each weapon to unlock its test slot.
training.notification.weaponUnlocked.bod: {{weapon}} can now be tested in the Training Arena.
training.notification.multi.title: Multi-Weapon Testing unlocked
training.notification.multi.body: The Training Arena rack can now test more than one weapon at a time.
lokChat.title: LOK Chat
lokChat.channelBlurb: What the crew say around the hideout, as they say it.
lokChat.channelEmpty: Quiet so far. Walk the hideout and the crew's chatter shows up here.
lokChat.noCrew: No one to message yet. Rescue crew on a run and they will show up here.
lokChat.footer: LOK Chat runs on this device. No account, no network.
lokChat.quick.run: How did my last run look?
lokChat.clearConfirm: Clear every LOK Chat conversation on this device? This also resets how well the crew know you.
share.title: Share your run
share.cardFailed: Couldn't draw the card. Try again.
share.linkNote: These carry your result and the game link. To send the picture or clips, use Share… or Save.
share.clipsIntro: Pick any part of the match you just played. The last half minute is kept in short pieces, along with your highlight moments. Everything stays on your device until you share it.
share.noClips: No clips were recorded this time. Clip capture needs a browser that can record the game, and it only keeps the most recent stretch.
tutorial.move.title: Move
tutorial.move.body.touch: Drag anywhere on the left side of the screen to walk. Keep moving: standing still is how you get caught.
tutorial.move.body.desktop: Use WASD or the arrow keys to walk. Keep moving: standing still is how you get caught.
tutorial.fight.title: Your weapon fires itself
tutorial.fight.body: No aiming and no button. Walk toward the crew and your weapon hits whatever is in range. Take down three of them.
tutorial.gems.title: Grab the glowing gems
tutorial.gems.body: Enemies drop XP gems when they fall. Walk over them to collect. Coins and hearts work the same way.
tutorial.pet.title: Your LokPet fights beside you
tutorial.pet.body: Your companion follows you and attacks on its own. Stay close to it, it grows stronger every run.
tutorial.dash.title: Dash out of trouble
tutorial.dash.body.touch: Tap the Dash button at the bottom right to burst away from a swarm. It recharges, so use it freely.
tutorial.dash.body.desktop: Press Shift (or click the Dash button) to burst away from a swarm. It recharges, so use it freely.
tutorial.level.title: Level up
tutorial.level.body: Enough gems and you level up. Pick a card: a new weapon, or a stronger version of one you already have.
tutorial.survive.title: Survive the block
tutorial.survive.body: Keep moving, keep collecting, and keep leveling. Clear the block before the crew clears you. You've got this.
lok.light.title: Lok · Lights out
lok.light.optics: It's getting dark out here. Low-Light Optics from the Vendor cuts the night tint by three quarters, so you can see what's coming.
lok.light.weapons: Still dark? Weapons that glow, like the Phosphor Evoker Staff, light up the dark zones around you.
cheat.master.first: Dev Mode access is on. The Cheat bar is open in Settings and LOK Chat.
cheat.master.again: Dev Mode access is already on.
cheat.unlocks.on: Every unlock is open (Dev Mode). Your real progress is untouched.
disc.spin.surface: Spin the disc. Tap to play or pause.
disc.spin.hint: Drag around the disc to spin it. Tap it to play or pause.
disc.pull.hint: Drag the disc up to pull the song out
disc.pull.title: Now spinning
disc.pull.spinHint: Drag around the disc to spin it. Swipe down to put it back.
settings.jukebox.shelvesBody: One row of discs per album, with the next one sliding in when you swipe up or down. Off puts every disc back on a single row.
settings.jukebox.gesturesBody: Spin a disc with your finger without changing the song, and drag the centered disc up to pull its song out to a full screen. Off keeps the discs tap-only.
jukebox.sleep: Sleep timer: tap to pause the music after 15, 30, 60 or 90 minutes
settings.jukebox.awake: Keep the screen on in the Jukebox Room
settings.jukebox.awakeBody: While music plays in the Jukebox Room your screen stays awake, so you can watch a whole song. It uses a little more battery. Off lets the screen sleep as usual.
settings.power.title: Power, storage and data
settings.power.intro: Everything that uses battery, space on this device or the network, in one place. All of it is yours to turn down or off.
settings.power.saverBody: Trims what costs the most power: the run frame rate, the music-reactive glow and disc effects, the Jukebox Room screen lock and the drifting background animations. It never changes the fight itself or your rewards. Auto switches on when the battery is low and not charging, or when your browser Data Saver is on.
settings.power.status.dataSaver: Saving power: Data Saver is on
settings.power.status.manual: Saving power: turned on by you
settings.power.capBody: The most frames per second a run uses while the saver is active. Lower is gentler on the battery. This only lowers your normal frame pacing, never raises it.
settings.power.controlsBody: Shows the song and play, skip and seek buttons on your lock screen, headphones and watch. Off removes them from the device.
settings.power.playtimeBody: Sends a small tally of active play time to your GSix account so it shows on your profile. Nothing else about how you play. Off stops the counter.
settings.power.storageBody: Your save and the music or media files you added live on this device only. Nothing here is uploaded.
settings.power.persist.done: Done. Your browser will keep this save when space runs low.
settings.power.persist.denied: Your browser said no. Installing the game to your home screen often helps.
settings.power.persistBody: Protecting asks the browser not to clear this game's data if the device runs low on space. Some browsers decide on their own.
settings.power.networkBody: Only four things ever leave your device: crash details (automatically if on, or when you press Send to LOK Services), the play-time tally (if on), the daily message file (if on, a plain read of one public file), and the music link you paste yourself when you ask to play one. No ads, no trackers, no background uploads, and nothing runs after you close the game.
saveGuard.title: Open in two tabs
saveGuard.body: Another tab just saved. To protect your progress this tab has paused saving. Load the newest save, or keep what this tab has.
settings.power.tabGuardBody: If the game is open in two tabs, the older tab pauses saving and asks which progress to keep, so one tab never wipes what the other earned. Off lets every tab save freely.
settings.power.dailyBody: Once a day the game reads one small file from its own site and may show a short line from the 616 on your hideout strip. It carries nothing about you. It never loads while the battery saver or Data Saver is on. Off stops it.
challenge.title: Challenge code
challenge.body: Got a code from a friend? Enter it to play their block on their night: same map, same waves, same loot rolls. Then compare how far each of you got.
challenge.badFormat: That does not look like a challenge code. It reads like 616.block.0000.0
challenge.badCheck: That code has a typo. Check each character.
challenge.badArea: This game does not have that block.
challenge.locked: You have not unlocked that block yet.
crash.send.failed: Could not send. Check your connection and try again.
crash.send.unavailable: Sending is not set up in this copy of the game.
settings.power.sendCrashBody: The game kept details of the last crash on this device. This sends that short, scrubbed text to LOK Services once, whatever the switch above says. It has no account, no device id and no page content.
settings.jukebox.favShelfBody: Songs you heart in the Jukebox Room gather on their own shelf at the front.
settings.jukebox.recentShelfBody: Your latest songs, newest first, on a shelf at the front of the room.
settings.jukebox.historyBody: Counts plays and listening time on this device only, so the shelves and play counts can work. Nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.jukebox.historyStats: {{plays}} plays · {{time}} listened on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
inv.title: Inventory
inv.subtitle: Everything you are carrying
inv.packsEmpty: No sealed packs yet. Packs you find on runs or buy in the card shop land here and stack up, so you can open them whenever you like.
inv.autoOpen: Open packs the moment I get them
inv.autoOpenBody: Off keeps new packs sealed here so you can stack them.
inv.materialsEmpty: No materials yet. Runs, chests and veteran foes drop them.
inv.relicsEmpty: Nothing forged yet. The Workshop turns materials into relics.
inv.runFoundSealed: Sealed and waiting in Items. Open them whenever you like.
